blocks.tamil_translation: and hold firmly to Him, He will admit them into mercy and grace from Him; and He will also show them the straight path (leading) to Himself.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (إِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ أٰمَنُوا فِي الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ اْلاَشْهَادُ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, We will help Our messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the (Hereafter) Day when the witnesses (come and) stand.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (اَلَّذِينَ أٰمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوآ إِيمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ أُولٰئِكَ لَهُمُ اْلأَمْنُ وَهُمْ مُّهْتَدُونَ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: Those who have Iman and then do not mix their (pure) faith with the injustice (of associating partners with Allah) — it is they who have security; and it is they who are rightly guided.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (وَالَّذِينَ أٰمَنُوآ أَشَدُّ حُباًّ لِلّهِ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: But those who believe are firmest in their love for Allah.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say: “Indeed my Salah, my (other) worship, my living and my dying all belong to Allah, the Rabb of all the worlds.”
